refnamediv.refpurpose: Write table or timeseries to a Parquet or Arrow file

listitem.para: Scalar string specifying the output file. Supported extensions are .parquet and .arrow.
A table or timeseries containing the data to write.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: parquetWrite writes the contents of a table or timeseries to a Parquet (.parquet) or Arrow (.arrow) file.
Each column of the file corresponds to a column of the table.
The name of the column are the same as in the table.
